port.desc: UDP port used by the Palworld dedicated server.

BaseCampMaxNumInGuild.desc: Maximum number of bases allowed per guild.

bAllowGlobalPalboxExport.desc: Allow exporting Pals through the Global Palbox.

bAllowGlobalPalboxImport.desc: Allow importing Pals through the Global Palbox.

run.command: sh -lc 'SOURCE=/pufferpanel/linux64/steamclient.so; DEST=/pufferpanel/Pal/Binaries/Linux/steamclient.so; CONFIG=/pufferpanel/Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/PalWorldSettings.ini; DEFAULT=/pufferpanel/DefaultPalWorldSettings.ini; BASES="${BaseCampMaxNumInGuild}"; EXPORT="${bAllowGlobalPalboxExport}"; IMPORT="${bAllowGlobalPalboxImport}"; case "$BASES" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "Invalid BaseCampMaxNumInGuild: $BASES" >&2; exit 1;; esac; case "$EXPORT" in true|True|1) EXPORT=True;; false|False|0) EXPORT=False;; *) echo "Invalid bAllowGlobalPalboxExport: $EXPORT" >&2; exit 1;; esac; case "$IMPORT" in true|True|1) IMPORT=True;; false|False|0) IMPORT=False;; *) echo "Invalid bAllowGlobalPalboxImport: $IMPORT" >&2; exit 1;; esac; if [ ! -f "$DEST" ]; then cp "$SOURCE" "$DEST" || exit 1; fi; chmod +x /pufferpanel/Pal/Binaries/Linux/PalServer-Linux-Shipping || exit 1; mkdir -p /pufferpanel/Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer || exit 1; chown 1000:1000 /pufferpanel/Pal/Saved /pufferpanel/Pal/Saved/Config /pufferpanel/Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer || exit 1; if [ ! -s "$CONFIG" ]; then cp "$DEFAULT" "$CONFIG" || exit 1; fi; grep -q "^OptionSettings=(" "$CONFIG" || { echo "OptionSettings not found" >&2; exit 1; }; sed -i -E "s/BaseCampMaxNumInGuild=[0-9]+/BaseCampMaxNumInGuild=$BASES/" "$CONFIG" || exit 1; if grep -q "bAllowGlobalPalboxExport=" "$CONFIG"; then sed -i -E "s/bAllowGlobalPalboxExport=(True|False)/bAllowGlobalPalboxExport=$EXPORT/" "$CONFIG" || exit 1; else sed -i "/^OptionSettings=(/ s/)$/,bAllowGlobalPalboxExport=$EXPORT)/" "$CONFIG" || exit 1; fi; if grep -q "bAllowGlobalPalboxImport=" "$CONFIG"; then sed -i -E "s/bAllowGlobalPalboxImport=(True|False)/bAllowGlobalPalboxImport=$IMPORT/" "$CONFIG" || exit 1; else sed -i "/^OptionSettings=(/ s/)$/,bAllowGlobalPalboxImport=$IMPORT)/" "$CONFIG" || exit 1; fi; chown 1000:1000 "$CONFIG" || exit 1; chmod 644 "$CONFIG" || exit 1; exec runuser -u ubuntu -- env HOME=/home/ubuntu /pufferpanel/Pal/Binaries/Linux/PalServer-Linux-Shipping Pal -port=${port}'
